title: Failure: date_diff cannot parse date values
description: A date_diff step may fail when one or both selected columns contain values pandas cannot parse as dates under errors='raise'.
planner_guidance: If the user expects invalid dates to become missing values, use errors='coerce'. Otherwise keep errors='raise' so data quality issues are visible.

example.query: Calculate days from order_date to ship_date
example.problem: Some values in ship_date are not valid dates.
example.resolution: Use errors='coerce' only when the user accepts missing durations for bad date values.

rag_note: date_diff should not silently hide date parsing problems unless the workflow explicitly uses coerce.
